scientific_integrity: The proof is exact and unrestricted. Finite exact-integer computation corroborates 2<=k<=8 and 2<=n<=10000; it is not an infinite proof. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Integer k at least 2 only; k=1 admits composite zero n=18. Direct evaluation can require factorization. Exact proof uses Euler product and local identities; independent audit and comprehensive historical-priority verification have not been performed.
title: A sharp composite gap for a Dirichlet-inverse prime detector
